Innoviti Technologies has appointed Ramdas Parameswaran as Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Parameswaran has over 20 years of experience in finance across the FMCG, ecommerce and insurtech sectors. He has held finance leadership roles at Hindustan Unilever (HUL), PepsiCo, Heinz and Flipkart. Before joining Innoviti, he served as CFO of Acko Life Insurance.
His areas of experience include business finance, controllership, investor relations, fundraising, due diligence, finance automation and supply chain.
At Innoviti, Parameswaran will oversee the Finance, Legal, Compliance and Administration functions.

Commenting on the appointment, Rajeev Agrawal, Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Innoviti Technologies, said, “We are pleased to welcome Ramdas to Innoviti. His extensive experience across diverse industries and high-growth consumer-facing retail and financial services businesses will not only help us accelerate growth in our existing products, but also contribute to the product roadmap itself.”
Parameswaran said, “I am excited to join Innoviti at a time when the company is turning profitable and look forward to working with the team to accelerate the profitable growth multifold.”

Innoviti has received final authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to operate as an online payment aggregator. The company is backed by investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, FMO, Catamaran Ventures and Patni Family Office.
